title: Representative equation for ordinary tensor realization models before scalar specialization
statement: Let B be a symmetric monoidal closed Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with functorial flat resolutions, T a scheme, and Rₛ a sheaf of commutative rings on its pro-etale site. Let F from B-valued sheaves to Rₛ-module sheaves be an additive equivalence, LF its specified derived realization, and eps the specified localization factor isomorphism. Let P be a class of K-flat source cochain complexes preserved by F in the flat-term K-flat target class, with fully faithful restriction of derived bifunctors to pairs in P. Let a be a normalized intrinsic tensor model and b an ordinary tensor comparison for F [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-realization]. For X,Z in P, the constructed finiteScalarTensorRealizationForOrdinaryModels satisfies the representative equation: applying LF to the fixed source representative, then the constructed comparison, then a.tensor on the two eps maps equals eps on the total source tensor, followed by the localization of the signed total comparison of b, followed by a.representative. The fixed representative is that of [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-resolution], and the signed total comparison is that of [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-complex].

source.place: Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product, proof on flat-term K-flat representatives; categories.tex Tag 04VK, lemma-properties-right-localization; specialization of the proved representative-descent equation

proof.text: Unfold finiteScalarTensorRealizationForOrdinaryModels, finiteScalarTensorRealizationForModels and finiteScalarTensorRealizationForCoefficients. Apply finiteScalarTensorRealizationOfRepresentatives_fac with the two derived localization functors, the complex functor induced by F, LF, eps, the representative classes and their preservation, fully faithful restriction, the fixed source representative, a.representative, and finiteScalarTotalTensorIsoOfOrdinary F b. Total tensor objects are definitionally the cochain mapBifunctor objects; the local reducibility setting exposes only the bifunctor shell while leaving sheafification folded.

theorem finiteScalarTensorRealizationForOrdinaryModels_representative
    (B : Type u₁) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B] [MonoidalCategory B]
    [MonoidalPreadditive B] [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B]
    [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B] (T : Scheme.{u})
    (Rₛ : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (F : Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B ⥤ proEtaleRingModules T Rₛ)
    [F.Additive] [F.IsEquivalence]
    (LF : DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules T Rₛ))
    (eps : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ LF ≅ F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (P : ObjectProperty (CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ℤ))
    (hP : ∀ Q, P Q → (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso _ (.up ℤ)).kFlat Q)
    (hF : ∀ Q, P Q → proEtaleFlatRepresentatives T Rₛ
      ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q))
    (ff : ((whiskeringLeft (P.FullSubcategory × P.FullSubcategory)
      (DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ×
        DerivedCategory (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B))
      (DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules T Rₛ))).obj
      ((P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q).prod (P.ι ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q))).FullyFaithful)
    (a : ProEtaleTensorModel T Rₛ)
    (b : tensor (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ⋙ F ≅
      (F.prod F) ⋙ @tensor (proEtaleRingModules T Rₛ) _
        (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Rₛ))
    (X Z : CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B) ℤ)
    (hx : P X) (hz : P Z) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory Rₛ
    LF.map ((finiteScalarFixedTensorRepresentativeForCoefficients B T P hP).hom.app
        (⟨X, hx⟩, ⟨Z, hz⟩)) ≫
      ((finiteScalarTensorRealizationForOrdinaryModels B T Rₛ F LF eps P hP hF ff a b).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj X)).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Z) ≫
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom (eps.hom.app X) (eps.hom.app Z)) =
    eps.hom.app (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor X Z
      (curriedTensor (Sheaf (ProEt.topology T) B))) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((finiteScalarTotalTensorIsoOfOrdinary F b).hom.app (X, Z)) ≫
      a.representative.hom.app
        (⟨(F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X, hF X hx⟩,
         ⟨(F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Z, hF Z hz⟩)
